screen with an atomic symbol between the two words (l also have this image ready).
Let players input or select letters to form words.
• Have a word validation feature (via dictionary or predefined list).
• Include a score counter, timer, and hint system
(like revealing a letter).
• Work on iOS first, but ideally be exportable to Android later.
• Include light/dark mode switching that
complements the existing backgrounds.
• Be beginner-friendly to build and edit (no-code
or visual logic preferred).
